balls.text: gone! Fourth catch for Abhishek tonight! This time he's at long-off, and waits patiently for the ball to come at him. Unadkat bowled this slower ball on the fuller side of a length, and around sixth stump. Hooda went lofting at it, but couldn't clear the boundary. I think the ball stopped on the surface there
wide ball. Unadkat bowls short and at a change of pace, but goes wide of off. Hooda lets it go, and the ball shapes away
full ball, and just outside off. Driven hard to deep cover point
Good running! Hooda got a full toss slightly wide of off, and lofted it to deep extra cover. Reddy took it on the bounce by moving to his right from deep cover point
slower ball on a length, and around seventh stump. He punches hard to deep cover, and doesn't run
gets across, and scoops for four! That raise the 150 for CSK. The ball was on the fuller side, and wide of off. But Hooda went far too across, and sent that chipping behind the wicket to fine leg
lovely defence... someone hear the Chepauk acknowledge that! Fuller side of a length from Harshal, who bowled jut outside off, as Khaleel blocked firmly with his head down

great work by Kishan!! He was placed at deep-backward point, and ran to his right to pat the ball back after it came to him on the bounce. It was a low full toss from Harshal around off, as Hooda sliced it aerially. He ran only one, though, since there's only one ball left

pings the first tier behind the wicket... and it's also a high full toss! Harshal bowled a slower ball which ended up arriving above Hooda's waist, and on leg. Hooda had a heave, and sent it flaying over the leg side over a straghtish fine leg
a low full toss in the channel outside off, and Hooda opens the face of the bat to chip towards long-off. Again, they don't run
another slower ball, and this on a short of a length, and outside off. Slashed to long-off, and they don't run
wide ball. A slower bouncer from Harshal, who banged it hard around sixth stump. The ball ballooned off the pitch, and Hooda let it go
short delivery on middle, and he looks to pull. But the ball goes to the keeper's left off the bottom of the bat

top edge to short third. Harshal went wide of the crease, and bowled a slower ball. It was also dipping, and arrived as a low full toss on off. Noor went swiping at it across the line, and ended up getting a little top edge behind the wicket. That little bit of edge, though, was enough, as Shami moved to his right to complete the catch
an attempted yorker, and the ball lands as a low full toss on middle. Noor backs away a bit, and squeezes it back down the pitch
this swings in, and arrives as a near yorker on off. Pushed down towards mid-on
full and just outside off, and Noor hoicks this to long-on

tickled behind by Kamboj. He looked to have a swing at this short-of-a-length ball just outside off, and closed the face of the bat. But he got a faint - and an almost inaudible - outside edge to Klaasen, who only moved a step to his right to take the catch comfortably
shorter side again from Cummins, but he bowls this on the stumps. Hooda looks to pull, but it goes off his pads to short fine leg
shorter side of a length, and on middle and off. Hooda punches it on the bounce to extra cover
follows the short ball up with a very full one just outside off. Clipped toward midwicket
manages to chip this short ball just outside off, and beats both Harshal, and mid-off to his right. Two runs for Kamboj
short in length, and pitching around fifth stump. Kamboj blocks it down, as the ball comes on pretty slow off the pitch

slashed to point!! A soft dismissal for Dhoni. He went flashing at this short and wide ball outside off, and did so pretty late. Again, like in the previous ball, he went reaching out for it without any foot movement. This time, though, he ended up chipping it straight to Abhishek to send the Chepauk back to silence
bottom edge on to the keeper. Dhoni looks to swat-pull at this short and wide-ish ball outside off, but he does so without really getting to the line of the ball
short in length on middle and off, and it goes towards midwicket off his pad, as he looked to swipe
past the outside edge again! Cummins bowls on the shorter side of a length around sixth stump. Dhoni looks to punch forward, but sees the ball go past the outside edge
short of a length on off or thereabouts. He gets on top of the bounce to push towards mid-on
beaten! Shorter side of a length, and in the corridor outside off. Hooda looked to punch this without any foot movement, and missed, as the ball went past the outside edge
full again, but this is just outside off. Dhoni looks to drive towards cover, but gets an inside edge to midwicket
full and swinging in at 139kph. It pitches on middle, and is pushed back towards Cummins
short of a length, and just outside off. He opens the face of the bat to punch it to deep point
short of a length just outside off, and turning away. Punched down to long-off
on a length on middle and leg, and turning away. Hooda nudges towards square leg, and Dhoni points out for a second run midway into the first
on the fuller side of a length, and Dhoni looks to clip but gets the ball off his hips to short fine leg
quicker from Zeeshan, as he bowls this on a length on middle, and lets it turn in. Blocked back by Dhoni

swung away, Dhoni style! The bat swing is so powerful an complete that the ball goes behind square. It was the googly dipping on a fullish length on middle and leg, and Dhoni again came down to attack it
Dhoni skips down the pitch, and nudges this fullish ball on the stumps to midwicket
on a length, and around sixth stump. Pushed gently to cover point

taken at long-on! That was sent up very high into the sky, and Abhishek did well to keep his eyes on the ball and grab it close to his chest. Unadkat bowled on a length, and just outside off. The ball shaped back in only slightly, and Dube went through his attempted loft. He didn't middle the ball, though, and only sent it right into the fielder's lap
on the fuller side of a length, and just outside off. Hooda dabs it to deep third by playing it late
a bit fuller than the previous ball, and this is on middle and off. lipped by Dube, who reads the slower ball, and gets a single to deep midwicket
on a length on the stumps, and angling in. It hits Dube's pad outside leg as he looks to clip, and the ball dribbles to short third
angling in, and full on middle and off. Hooda opens the face of the bat, and drives to deep cover
Harshal goes wide of the crease, and bowls on a length on off. It is clipped behind square by Hooda to get off the mark

flying man Mendis! Ian Bishop, on air, says the line of the season: "Which is his weak side we never know". He was placed at long-off, and moved a few steps to his left before throwing and flinging himself to his left full stretch. The ball stuck, and Chepauk was left shocked. Harshal had bowled a slower ball on a full length, and outside off. Brevis read the lack of pace, and lofted it hard and flat, only for Mendis to ruin his mood
swatted over extra cover! Lovely hit! A short ball, and wide of off, but Brevis rides the bounce, and hammers this with a flat bat. Almost like a Dhoni hit from back in the day
slashed on the bounce to point. Harshal goes wide of the crease, and bowls on a short of a length, and around sixth stump
short in length, and just outside off. This gets up well, though, and is punched to long-on with a slightly angled bat
this stays slightly low off a short of a length, and just outside off. Punched towards cover

third six of the over! It is turning around for CSK, and how! This time he only leans into this left over long-off, as Mendis bowls slow and full, and a bit wide of off. Brevis tonked that hard and high for six
quicker, and very full. It is around seventh stump, and is jammed back to Mendis' left

pulled for another huge six!! Again Mendis bowls it slow, but this is short, and on middle and leg. Brevis shifts his weight back, and gets his front leg out of the way to club the ball over midwicket
low full toss just outside off, and driven to long-off

turn and bounce there for Mendis! He bowls short and slow, and wide of off. The ball grips too, before finishing wide of off after turning away. Slashed towards deep cover, with his bottom hand off the bat
launched down the ground!! That is a no-look hit as well, as he backs away a bit, and thumps this full ball angling into leg for a big six

drilled through extra cover this time! There's no foot movement, as he reaches out at this full and slower ball slightly wide of off, and crashes the ball between the fielders at extra cover and mid-off
driven wide of long-off! That was driven with nice timing, and beat a sliding mid-off to his right, as Shami angled this in, and ended up bowling a low full toss on the stumps
a yorker-length ball around fifth stump, and that is dragged to long-on with his bottom coming off the bat
good bowling! He cuts the pace off, and bowls short just outside off. Brevis looks to pull, but is beaten
short in length on middle, and clipped to fine leg. They pinch two runs in no time there
bowls short and a little wide of off. Brevis looks to leap and upper cut, but is beaten. Half an appeal for caught behind by Klaasen, and given not out. Called first bouncer, though
Slapped away to deep cover and just three runs and a wicket from this over
On a length outside off, cut to point
Tossed up full outside off, driven down the ground to long-off
Knocks him over! This is on a length, and it's quicker too. Jadeja plays back to it and looks to work it leg side but ends up playing all around it and sees his middle stump knocked back
On a length around off, Brevis backs away and punches this down the ground to long-on
Floated full around off, driven out to mid-off
Tossed up full outside off, Jadeja hammers a grounded sweep to deep midwicket's left. Excellent work from Ishan Kishan to get around and dive to save two runs
On a length outside off, punched square for a single. The fielder again doesn't collect cleanly, a phenomenon not being seen for the first time today
On a length outside off, punched out to deep cover
Wrong'un floated full around off, Brevis swings it to deep midwicket's left off the inside half of the bat
Angles this length ball across him, Jadeja reaches out and cuts it past the cover fielder
That's gone high in the air as well, and that clears the fielders! Floated up outside off and Jadeja gets a hold of this one as he slogs this over long-on
Tossed full around middle, clipped out to deep midwicket. A quiet over from Kamindu
On a length outside off, Brevis backs away to cut it out to deep cover
Flicked out to deep midwicket
On a length around off, Jadeja gets an inside edge onto his pads and towards point
Jadeja misses the flick as this comes in with the angle
On a length outside off, pushed out to point

Shelled at long-off! Jadeja looks to take on this full ball outside off and it comes off the toe end. Harshal Patel has plenty of time to settle under it, but he misjudges it a little and has to backtrack a little as the ball comes down. It spills out of his hands. Jadeja had a look of dispair the moment he hit it, but he has got a reprieve!
Pitched up on a length outside off, pushed to point
On a length on off, punched out to deep point's left
Cut hard to backward point and a misfield allows them to run two easily
And Brevis gets going Legbreak on a length around off, Brevis makes room and slaps it back down the ground. Long-off didn't stand a chance
Ansari follows Brevis with a length ball as he tries to back away. Raps him on the pad as Brevis misses his flick
Cummins bowls a yorker around off, Brevis gets an inside edge onto his pads and gets a single as it deflects to the off side
Full outside off from around the wicket, whipped out to deep backward square leg
Very full around off, dug out towards mid-off for a single

Cummins with the breakthrough! Almost yorker length on the stumps, Mhatre again looks to go down the ground but ends up chipping it straight down Ishan Kishan's throat. He did back away to make room, but couldn't get the elevation or placement on this. Another brisk, impactful knock at the top from him
On a length outside off, Jadeja looks to heave it leg side and gets an inside edge towards short fine leg
Yorker on middle and off, dug out to mid-off for a quick single
Very full outside off, squeezed out to mid-off where Cummins can't collect cleanly and it allows them to run two
Full and very wide, Jadeja reaches out and plays this back to the bowler on the bounce
Edged in the gap! Jadeja pushes at this length ball outside off and gets a thick edge, but it's too fine for short third who can only watch it race away

Bye bye, Sam Curran! Short ball outside off cramps him for room. Curran looks to pull but it comes off the top edge and it flies straight to the deep midwicket fielder. Harshal with a little wag of the fielder to Curran as he walks off
Mhatre mistimes this as he takes on a slower ball full outside off, but it doesn't carry to deep midwicket running in
Length ball outside off, Curran looks to punch this down the ground and hits it into the ground and the ball balloons over the batter to mid-off's left
Unadkat now bowls this in the blockhole around middle, Mhatre backs away to jam it out to cover with the open face
Very full outside off, Mhatre digs it out to extra cover

Just past the extra cover fielder! This is a full toss around off and he drives it just wide enough of the fielder, who would have been in with a chance there. The fielder put in the dive at full stretch, but Mhatre had placed this well enough
Smacked down the ground! Mhatre continues to impress with some flamboyant strokemaking. It's a bouncer outside off, and he backs away and flat-bats it straight back over the bowler
On a length outside off and swinging in, Curran works it with the angle to deep midwicket
Full around off, pace off, Mhatre thrashes a drive to the extra cover fielder
Just beats mid-on! Sam Curran gets in on the action now. Length ball angled across and Curran frees his arms and slaps this wide of mid-on. The fielder puts in a dive, but it's beyond his reach
Bumped in short outside off, Mhatre looks to pull and gets an inside edge onto his hips. They take a single as the ball rolls behind point
Mhatre backs away to this length delivery and looks to punch it away on the off side but picks out the cover point fielder
Flayed away! Stands tall to this short of good length delivery and nails the pull over the midwicket fielder. A lot of authority in that stroke there!
Mhatre looks to cut away this length ball outside off. Gets it off the inside half of the bat onto the ground and towards cover
Curran punches this full ball on leg to mid-on. A misfield there from Unadkat allows them to take a single

Just clears mid-off tracking back! Full around off, Mhatre looks to drive this down the ground but it comes off the outside half of the bat. Ishan Kishan runs back and leaps with an outstretched arm but Mhatre gets enough elevation to get it over him and pick up another boundary
Angles in a full ball on middle and Curran clips it towards mid-on and they hare for a quick single
On a length around leg, tucked to midwicket
Full on off and going across him, Curran pushes it towards mid-off. A bit of confusion as Curran sends Mhatre back after starting off on the single, but the youngster has enough time to get back
On a length on off, 140kph, Mhatre taps it to cover for a single
Mhatre has picked up today from where he left off. This is full, and there's width on offer, and Mhatre crashes it away through cover point. He is completely unfazed by that first-ball wicket!
Full around middle, Mhatre punches it towards mid-on for a single
Slapped away past cover! Short and wide and Mhatre stands tall and punches it away to cover's left. The fielder puts in the dive but he's placed that perfectly
Shami pulls his length back as he delivers another outswinger. Mhatre meets it with a firm back-foot punch to cover
Pitched up full outside off, swing away again, Mhatre plays it to point
Shami nails the yorker and Curran can only inside edge it onto his pads trying to swing it leg side. The ball rolls to his left and they get their first run off the bat
Looks to take it away from Curran but misses on the line. That's too wide from Shami. Oh, and Shami's managed to disturb the stumps at the non-striker's end while loading up so it's a no-ball

Gone first ball! It's that perfect Test match delivery with the new ball, on a length outside off, shaping away. Rasheed pushes at it and gets a thick edge and Abhishek Sharma takes a sharp catch at slip!
shorter side of a length outside off, and turning in. Pulled wide of long-on, and Mendis gets the two runs for the win. SRH beat CSK for the first time in Chennai
on a length on his pads, and slog swept to deep-backward square leg
Wow, Brevis saves two! Incredible work there, as he runs and dives to his left, before parrying the ball back. Mendis had pulled this short ball from Jadeja
he angles this across, and bowls full and outside off. Mendis looks to sweep but mises

slower delivery, and short in length. It pitches on middle and leg, and finishes outside off, after Reddy lets it go. It is not called wide, but Reddy reviews. It remains a fair delivery, though, with the ball within the wide line
on a length on middle and leg, and chipped towards deep midwicket. Again they push for two, and make it safely
good work by the man at mid-off, who dives to his right to prevent a boundary. Short ball and good bounce for Khaleel around sixth stump, as Mendis swatted at it
clips this low full off his toes on the bounce to deep-backward square leg
Khaleel goes wide of the crease, and bowls on a short of a length just outside off. Mendis looked to punch, but got an inside edge to fine leg
slower ball, and full and just outside off. Mendis almost squats, before nudging towards deep-backward square. The call is for two, and they pinch it
short ball just outside off, beaten. Reddy went for the pull, but the ball didn't seem to have bounced as much as he expected
another wide... and SRH are getting closer. This lands almost past the pitch, and way outside leg. No chance for Reddy for even have a flick

sliced to deep-backward point! Pathirana went for the yorker, but ended up bowling a full toss bang on the middle of middle stump. Reddy was again backing away, and punched it even with losing his bottom hand off the bat
full ball on middle and leg, and chipped to midwicket, where the man dived to his left, but didn't get a hand
pulled hard to deep midwicket! He made room, and Pathirana bowled on off. Reddy backing away meant he had plenty of room to have a free swing of the bat
flicked from leg stump there, as Pathirana bowled an inswinging yorker. Reddy nearly lost his balance there, but still got two to fine leg
slower ball, and full on off. Pushed down, and mid-off cuts it off by tumbling to his left
slower ball, and angling across to be a wide outside off. Mendis looked to lash at it but missed. Another wide from Pathirana
chips this just wide of the man at cover for two to deep extra cover, as the ball is full and outside off
leading edge... but safe towards long-off. He looks to clip this full ball angling into off, but closes the face of the bat early
makes room, and Noor bowls on the shorter side on the stumps. It turns in, and is pulled on a few bounces to long-on
backs away, and looks to loft at this length ball just outside off, but gets an inside edge to midwicket. And this is another no-ball
slog swept to deep square leg! Full and dipping just outside off, and Mendis gets across to drill it in the gap for four
beaten! On a length, and quicker, and around sixth stump. Mendis looks to heave across the line, but misses
on a short of a length, and outside off. Swatted to long-off... and we hear the siren that indicates it's a front-foot no-ball
in between extra cover running towards the man running forward from deep cover!! Mendis opened the face of the bat, and lofted this fullish ball outside off, but mistimed, and got lucky
another yorker-length ball lands as a low full toss. This is on off, and Reddy can hardly help but tuck it back towards Pathirana
shorter side of a length on middle and leg, and clipped to fine leg
wide ball. He bangs it short, but it's too high, as it lands on leg. Mendis shaped to hook, but let it go
another attempted yorker, but this comes on as very full on the pads, with the ball swinging in. Clipped to beat the man at deep square leg to his left
on a short of a length, and around sixth stump. Chopped on the bounce to point
driven between mid-off and cover! Full and angling across, and arrives around fifth stump, as Mendis plays it from deep in the crease. There was no one at extra cover, and that was sent racing
bowls a low full toss on the stumps, as he goes for the yorker. Nudged towards midwicket by Mendis
on a fullish length on middle and off, and it hints to straighten. Dabbed towards point by Reddy

skied to long-off!! Why did Aniket have to go for the slog?! SRH already got 12 runs off the over, and there was no pressure of the required rate either. It was a googly from Noor, as he angled it across, and went full and around off. Aniket only looked down on the pitch while looking to loft, but that seemed to have come off the outside half of the bat. That big hit was hardly needed
a dipping yorker-length ball on off, as Mendis looks to push forward but gets an inside edge to Dhoni's right
slog swept to fine leg! Mendis upping the tempo here. He got across, and swung his bat at this full ball outside leg. So he had the room, and the space in the field, to play that
on a length on leg, and Mendis reverse sweeps to deep-backward point
lovely ball! Angling in on a fullish length just outside off, and turning away, as he's beaten in pushing forward
five wides... but I thought I heard a faint inside edge there. On a length on leg, and slanting down to beat Mendis' attempted flick. Actually, the sound was off Dhoni's gloves
superb bowling! The yorker arrives on middle as the ball swings in, and Aniket digs it out to point by opening the face of the bat
slower ball, and Aniket is foxed. Short in length, and in the corridor outside off. Aniket shaped to pull, seemed to have swung his bat early
this time he executes the yorker well. This is around sixth stump, and Aniket looks to drive but misses
another wide! This lands on a yorker length, but almost beyond the pitch
great work by Kamboj at deep third, as he runs and tumbles to his right to save a few runs. Short of a length, and climbing nicely around sixth stump, as Aniket punched it late for two
beaten! This slings on to arrive on the shorter side of a length, and just outside off. Aniket looks to punch but is beaten on the outside edge
this is on a length, and on middle and off. Aniket goes back to dab it down on the pitch
starts with a wide, as he bowls full and outside leg. Aniket looked to clip from deep in the crease, but missed

good catch by Curran!! He had almost run in a bit too far, before he backtracks to take the ball with a reverse cup, even as he ends up falling back. Another short delivery Noor, and around off. Kishan again shifted his weight back, and pulled it hard and flat. The ball did seem to travel off the bat, only for it to be perhaps too flat. Curran did well to grab it, and Kishan departs
pulled over square leg! Kishan is key if they are to hunt this down. Short in length on off, and Kishan goes back to get on top of the bounce, and club it for six
this is short on off, and straightens after pitching. Slashed to deep point
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. Kishan is nearly surprised by the bounce, before swatting to deep midwicket
short of a length, and angling across to arrive around sixth stump. Slashed to deep cover
Khaleel at short third is nearly beaten by the ball spinning away after landing in front, as Kishan cuts at this short and wide-ish ball outside off
bang! Six down the pitch! He let this fullish ball dip, and as it angled into him, he lofted it hard over Jadeja's head

Kishan comes down the pitch, and misses an attempted swipe. Jadeja is confident while appealing for lbw, but it's turned down. That was on the shorter side on the stumps, and the ball struck him above his knee
short of a length outside off, and turning in to finish closer. Cut on a few bounces to point
this dips on a fullish length around off, and hints to turn in. Whipped to deep midwicket for two
full and flat on middle, and swept off the inside edge to short fine leg
slog swept on the bounce to long-on moving to his left. Full and angling across, and just outside off, as Kishan swung hard
Full outside off, flicked out to deep midwicket
Full outside off, driven out to deep cover
A shot and a half from Aniket Verma! Back of a length around leg and he just whips it away behind square, swivelling on his toes
On a length outside off, tucked down to long-on
Kishan gets a slot ball and puts it away. Lofts it over cover and the beats the fielder in the deep as well
Length ball outside leg, tucked out to deep fine leg. Ah no, that went off his thighs, no bat there
Punches this one out to deep cover to get off the mark
This one goes on with the angle, full around leg, he looks to flick but misses
Pushed back to the bowler. Another length ball around off
On a length around off, he goes back to punch it to cover
Tossed up around middle, inside-edged onto his pads

That's a huuuuge wicket Klaasen chips this high in the air and Deepak Hooda does well to hold on! This is tossed up on middle, Klaasen backs away and looks to go downtown. Miscues it off the toe end as the ball holds in the wicket. Hooda grabs it in front of his chest and does well to keep his balance and not fall over backward. CSK right in this game!

Full around off, Kishan pushes it in front towards extra cover for a single. The fielder rushes in and has a shy at the stumps at the non-striker's end with no one backing up and that allows the batters to run a second
Beaten. Length ball goes past the outside edge as Kishan looks to cut
Slashed over the keeper! Short outside off, he throws his bat at it and gets a thick edge that flies behind. SRH won't mind this over at all!
Pushed down to long-on for a single. Length ball angling in from outside off and Klaasen is happy to take the single
That's a poor delivery and it's put away Curran angles it in from around the wicket but it's too straight and going down leg, Klaasen just helps it off his hips past short fine leg
On a length outside off, punched out square on the off side for a single
On a length and angled across him, Kishan goes back to cut it away to the off side sweeper
On a length on middle and length, tucked to deep midwicket
Tucks this length ball around off to long-on
Tossed up on middle, Klaasen eases it in the vacant midwicket area for a single
Slightly shorter, Kishan slaps it out to long-off
Tossed up on off, Kishan fends it back towards the bowler
Full around off, tucked to midwicket
And now Klaasen is beaten on the inside edge! On a length outside off, stays low to beat Klaasen's drive
Full on off, driven uppishly to mid-off

Oh, he's knocked him over! Impact player gets impact player! Offcutter that lands on a length around leg and beats Head's mighty swing across the line to clip the off bail! Travishek back in the hut and Kamboj lets out a roar
Back of length around leg, Kishan punches it towards mid-on and hares off for a single
138kph length ball angled across Kishan, who just steers it to short third
Pushed out to extra cover. This was a googly turning in from a length around off
Chipped comfortably over mid-off! This is floated up full outside off, and drifting in slightly. Head backs away and lofts it over the infield
Follows Head who was backing away, and Head manages to squeeze it out to cover

Kishan backs away and slaps this length back down the ground, but Noor dives and gets a hand on it to take the sting out of that shot so that mid-on can cut it out. That was a wrong'un outside off that came in. Physio comes out to check on Noor
Tossed on a length on middle, clipped into the vacant area to the bowler's left. Easy single
On a length on off and coming in with the angle, Kishan tucks it out to deep square leg
Crashed through cover! Overpitched outside off and Head has no problem in threading the gap
Head looks to whip away this short-ish ball around leg, but he can't connect. The ball hits him on the front pad
Length ball around leg, Head punches it to cover point
Swing and a miss. On a length on middle, Head backs away and exposes all three stumps and looks to clobber this leg-side but gets nothing but thin air as the ball flies over the stumps
Length ball around leg, Head misses his flick and it goes to Dhoni off his pads. A mild appeal, but that likely pitched and hit Head outside leg, so they don't bother with a review
Bashed down the ground Full around middle and off and going across, Head frees his arms and whacks this straight of mid-on
Banged in short outside off, Kishan arches back to ramp but misses
Driven over a leaping cover point fielder! Full outside off and Kishan leans into this lofted square drive that beats the fielder who almost got fingertips on it
